readme:
# DayDreamer 离散世界模型KL平衡

## 1. 问题

DayDreamer 离散世界模型KL平衡：实现下列接口并通过数值、边界和实验检查。

提取DayDreamer继承DreamerV2的KL balancing核心，固定alpha默认0.8；计算free-nats截断之前的KL，不实现RSSM或机器人在线训练。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
L=\alpha D_{KL}(\operatorname{sg}(q)\Vert p)+(1-\alpha)D_{KL}(q\Vert\operatorname{sg}(p)).
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `balanced_kl(posterior_logits: Tensor, prior_logits: Tensor, alpha: float=0.8) -> Tensor`

用log_softmax得到logq/logp。动力学项冻结整个q，包括概率与logq；表征项只冻结logp。alpha=1只更新prior，alpha=0只更新posterior。不能用一个未detach的KL乘权重代替。

## 4. 本题约定

posterior/prior logits为(B,K,C)，C>=2，alpha在[0,1]。K个独立分类潜变量的KL求和，然后按B平均。前向值与alpha无关，梯度分配依赖alpha。

校验辅助函数已提供。浮点输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，不修改输入；非法形状、类型、范围或掩码必须抛出 `ValueError`。

## 5. 交互图与确定性实验

`experiment.py` 在固定输入上调用提交的全部接口，记录学习或采样曲线与末端指标。实验逻辑和阈值见 T3，输出同样用于可视化。

可视化由 `viz/gen.py` 生成；T3 将你的函数传入同一实验并记录真实指标。这是小规模确定性教学实验，不是机器人基准成绩。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 来源与延伸

- [DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.14176) — Appendix D: DreamerV2 world model, KL balancing 0.8
- [Verified source](https://arxiv.org/html/2206.14176)
- [Verified source](https://openreview.net/pdf/67aa53972119733780dfb9a38ef34181f4d2f261.pdf)

核验日期：2026-10-28。扩展到完整论文系统还需要本题范围中明确省略的模型、数据和环境。

## 测试捕获的错误

- Dynamics KL wrongly updates the posterior encoder.
- Dynamics KL averages instead of summing independent categorical latents.

## 实验范围

提取DayDreamer继承DreamerV2的KL balancing核心，固定alpha默认0.8；计算free-nats截断之前的KL，不实现RSSM或机器人在线训练。

## 可重复实验记录

1个batch、2个潜变量、每个3类；固定posterior，prior从均匀开始，alpha=0.8，80步梯度下降(lr=1)。要求KL<初始1e-5且最大概率误差<0.002。

判题固定seed=42。计算采用CPU float64、显式输入，涉及优化时使用普通梯度更新；不下载数据集或模型权重。原生PyTorch与真实Pyodide/NumPy-WASM执行同一套T0–T3测试。阈值针对本教学实验。

en.title: DayDreamer Balanced Categorical World-Model KL
en.readme:
# DayDreamer Balanced Categorical World-Model KL

## 1. Exercise goal

DayDreamer Balanced Categorical World-Model KL: implement the interfaces below and verify numerical, boundary and experimental behavior.

Isolate the DreamerV2-style KL balancing used by DayDreamer, with default alpha=0.8. Compute KL before free-nats clipping; omit the RSSM and online robot training.

## 2. Core equations

$$
L=\alpha D_{KL}(\operatorname{sg}(q)\Vert p)+(1-\alpha)D_{KL}(q\Vert\operatorname{sg}(p)).
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `balanced_kl(posterior_logits: Tensor, prior_logits: Tensor, alpha: float=0.8) -> Tensor`

Use log_softmax for logq/logp. The dynamics term freezes all of q, both probabilities and logq; the representation term freezes logp. Alpha one updates only the prior, alpha zero only the posterior. A weighted undetached KL cannot reproduce this split.

## 4. Contract and boundaries

Posterior/prior logits are (B,K,C), C>=2, alpha in [0,1]. Sum KL over K categorical latents and average B. Forward values are alpha-invariant while gradient allocation depends on alpha.

Validation helpers are provided. All floating inputs are finite CPU float32/float64; do not mutate inputs. Invalid shape, dtype, range or mask arguments raise `ValueError`.

## 5. Deterministic experiment and visualization

`experiment.py` calls every submitted interface on fixed inputs and records a learning or sampling curve and terminal metrics. T3 states the behavioral thresholds; the visualization uses the same outputs.

The visualization is generated by `viz/gen.py`; T3 runs the same experiment with your functions and records its actual metrics. These are small deterministic teaching results, not a robot benchmark.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Sources and extensions

- [DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.14176) — Appendix D: DreamerV2 world model, KL balancing 0.8
- [Verified source](https://arxiv.org/html/2206.14176)
- [Verified source](https://openreview.net/pdf/67aa53972119733780dfb9a38ef34181f4d2f261.pdf)

Verified 2026-10-28. Extending this operator to the full paper requires the omitted model, data and environment described in the scope above.

# DayDreamer: Solution notes

Use log_softmax for logq/logp. The dynamics term freezes all of q, both probabilities and logq; the representation term freezes logp. Alpha one updates only the prior, alpha zero only the posterior. A weighted undetached KL cannot reproduce this split.

Identify reduction axes, validity masks and gradient paths from the equations before comparing a small hand calculation. Test oracles do not call the reference implementation.

## Mistakes caught by the tests

- Dynamics KL wrongly updates the posterior encoder.
- Dynamics KL averages instead of summing independent categorical latents.

## Experimental scope

Isolate the DreamerV2-style KL balancing used by DayDreamer, with default alpha=0.8. Compute KL before free-nats clipping; omit the RSSM and online robot training.

## Reproducible protocol

One example, two latent variables, three classes each; fixed posterior and uniform initial prior, alpha .8, 80 gradient steps at lr 1. Require KL below 1e-5 of initial and maximum probability error below .002.

The judge fixes seed 42. All calculations use CPU float64, explicit inputs and plain gradient updates where applicable; no datasets or model weights are downloaded. Native PyTorch and actual Pyodide/NumPy-WASM run the same T0–T3 suite. Thresholds refer to this teaching adaptation.
